violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: steak=94-123F, fajita=112F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.(Discarded)

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The temperature of the hot water at the handwashing sink located at the front serving line, is below the minimum temperature of 100F required.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Adjust the temperature at the sink to at least 100F. In the mean time hand washing should be done at the other hand sink that’s has adequate hot water temperature.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device at the Online serving table as follow: brown rice=120/124F white steamed rice=124F, pinto beans=v119F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI- All discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Tissue Supplied
violations.observation: Observed that toilet tissue was not provided at the women’s restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide toilet tissue at each toilet to minimize hand contact with fecal waste.

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Observed that the women’s restroom is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
